name: ArpitKanungo/mock-pricelabs-api
what_it_holds: Verified via raw db.json: a 30-row mock JSON of STR-style listings (id, propertyName, city, lat/lng, basePrice $1.99-$129.99). Explicitly toy/demo data mimicking a PriceLabs-shaped listing feed; no occupancy, comp-set, or booking fields. One corrupted row. Updated 2 May 2026.
why_useful: Not real data (confirmed mock/demo, unrealistic prices) — a dead end for actual signal, but the schema shape (property, geo, base nightly rate) is the minimum viable structure a real PriceLabs-style comp-set pull would need, useful only as a template if the team ever builds its own scraper against a public rate-shopping tool.
themes: wildcard: a revenue manager at a large vacation-rental property-manage
wildcard: an Airbnb superhost / small property manager who uses open-s
why_all: Not real data (confirmed mock/demo, unrealistic prices) — a dead end for actual signal, but the schema shape (property, geo, base nightly rate) is the minimum viable structure a real PriceLabs-style comp-set pull would need, useful only as a template if the team ever builds its own scraper against a public rate-shopping tool.

Confirms PriceLabs (a dominant STR dynamic-pricing tool many hosts use) has a documented API shape worth knowing about, but this particular repo has nothing usable; flagged only so a follow-up agent doesn't re-discover and re-evaluate it.

name: natalan/pricelabs-price-checker
what_it_holds: Verified via WebFetch: a small WordPress plugin that calls the PriceLabs API to show dynamic pricing on a direct-booking site. PHP integration code only, no bundled comp-set data; exact fields pulled not visible from the page (would need the .php source).
why_useful: Confirms PriceLabs exposes a live, third-party-callable API that individual hosts already integrate against; a public confirmation that a comp-set/pricing acquisition path exists, worth a deeper source read if the team wants to explore PriceLabs' public-facing (non-paid-tier) endpoints for realised-ADR proxies (gap #2).
themes: wildcard: a revenue manager at a large vacation-rental property-manage
why_all: Confirms PriceLabs exposes a live, third-party-callable API that individual hosts already integrate against; a public confirmation that a comp-set/pricing acquisition path exists, worth a deeper source read if the team wants to explore PriceLabs' public-facing (non-paid-tier) endpoints for realised-ADR proxies (gap #2).

name: api-evangelist/opensky
what_it_holds: Independent third-party API profile of OpenSky Network: OpenAPI specs, JSON Schema, auth/rate-limit docs, pricing plans. Not the API itself and not data — pure documentation/spec artifacts. Created/modified 2026-06-13.
why_useful: Useful only as a faster on-ramp to understand OpenSky's REST/Trino surface before building a puller; no standalone data value beyond the official client above.
themes: wildcard: an airline network planner who knows capacity, schedule, far
